supersedes: docs/measurement/STRONGEST_PERMITTED_CLAIM.json 1.3.0 (PR #51), for the claims it contradicts only

engine.note: the published engine. PR #51's action-set numbers were produced on Stockfish 16 and say so.

detection.statement: A frozen board predicate identifies positions in which a named chess condition holds, and the trigger has no parameter through which the played move could reach it.

recording.statement: Whether the player's move satisfies a named board-only property of the resulting position is recordable from the position and the move alone.

rc06_domain_fact.statement: Where the opponent threatens mate in one, the best move removing that threat is the engine's own best move on 242 of 242 items where the rule prescribes anything, at a median cost of 1 cp; not answering loses >=100 cp on 84.9%.

production_record_contents.statement: Per decision, before reveal: position, move, seconds_taken, stated read, confidence with its scale and grid version, every distinct move physically placed on the board in touch order, and a randomised alternative-move probe with a denominator.

rc06_separation_is_specificity.statement_refuted: RC-06's separation of +0.768 shows the prescribed action is specific to its trigger.
rc06_separation_is_specificity.why: b_valid|T+ and b_valid|T- are computed under different definitions of B. On T+, B = the opponent has no mate in one. On T-, B = the opponent has no check at all.

measured.positive_control: reproduces the published .968 / .200 / +0.768 within its own intervals on an independent draw

rc06_is_eligible.statement_refuted: RC-06 answer-the-mate-threat is an eligible rule class.
rc06_is_eligible.why: G5 is the only gate it uniquely passes and G5 reads separation.

only_one_predicate_branches.statement_refuted: _threat_satisfies is the only predicate of the twelve that branches on the trigger.
only_one_predicate_branches.why: _promotion_stop_satisfies (RC-12) branches on the same board condition without calling the trigger function, and says so in its own docstring. The shipped detector tests for a literal `_trigger(` call.

lone_king_defends_is_the_rule_of_the_squ.statement_refuted: `the opponent has no knight, bishop, rook or queen` is the condition under which the rule of the square is the whole story.
lone_king_defends_is_the_rule_of_the_squ.why: An enemy pawn can capture the passer, be captured, block after a capture, and promote into a piece that stops it.

exclusion_clauses.note: clauses overlap. The own-piece clause is the one that is not about an opposing resource, and it accounts for 2.1%.

rc13_scope_predicate_is_its_claim.statement_refuted: `any knight promotion checks and no queen promotion checks` tests whether the knight does something a queen cannot.
rc13_scope_predicate_is_its_claim.why: The claim is about one promotion square. The matched comparison holds `from` and `to` fixed.
rc13_scope_predicate_is_its_claim.note: RC-13's b_valid is .000 on both cells and both splits, so its verdict does not move; the in-scope denominator does.

a5_on_expected_score.statement_refuted: A5_beats_incumbent is a gate on the expected-score scale.
a5_on_expected_score.why: The ceiling anchor RC-00 mate-in-one scores +0.344 where the refuted floor RC-01 scores +0.564. Mean V* on RC-00's positive cell is exactly 1.000; in centipawns the cell reads +99255, the mate constant.

b_membership_is_rule_consistent_action.statement_refuted: move in B indicates rule-consistent action on RC-06.

g5_threshold_is_a_specificity_statistic.statement_refuted: gate G5's threshold -- the incumbent floor RC-01's separation of +0.600 -- is a specificity statistic.
g5_threshold_is_a_specificity_statistic.why: RC-01's as-stated noise cell is empty on 100% of its trigger-negative items: when there is no capturable-and-undefended piece, no legal move can take it. Its published b_valid|T- of .184 scores a DIFFERENT act, capturing the dearest DEFENDED piece.
g5_threshold_is_a_specificity_statistic.consequence: every candidate in the register was measured against a threshold set by a class whose own separation is not a specificity statistic

method_shaped_rules_escape_the_degenerat.statement_refuted: method-shaped rules, where B is a property of the move, do not have the degenerate-noise-cell problem (PR #49 H23, carried into D25's next-candidate recommendation).
method_shaped_rules_escape_the_degenerat.why: RC-11 and RC-18 are both method-shaped -- the prescription is `move it` -- and both are VACANT: as stated, neither prescribes anything on its negative cell.
method_shaped_rules_escape_the_degenerat.what_replaces_it: a rule class has a usable noise cell only where, with the trigger absent, the prescribed act STILL EXISTS AND CAN BE WRONG. That is a property of how the trigger's negative cell is constructed, not of the prescription's shape.

conditional_discrimination_vs_response_b.statement: Correct conditional discrimination and response bias / perform-B-everywhere take different interventions and are observationally equivalent under a saturated noise cell.
conditional_discrimination_vs_response_b.classifier: Bayes-optimal likelihood ratio handed the true generative model of both hypotheses -- an upper bound

unresolved.why: neither RC-00 nor RC-01 has been graded for a saturated noise cell, and every published comparison is against them
RC-11 is method-shaped, does not branch, T- prescription size .175, and has not been re-screened
the only production observation supporting M1 over M0, and shared/reveal.ts says it has never been measured
max |SMD| 0.573, untouched, and moot while the contrast is void
top-1 b_valid agrees between SF16 and SF17.1; action-set value stability, node/depth stability and WDL-model sensitivity are untested
no evidence that any of this is separable from general chess strength

new_criterion.asks: the prescription size on the trigger-negative cell, under the response predicate as the class's own prescription sentence states it
new_criterion.fails_if: near 1 -- the class has no noise cell and its separation is a fact about its predicate
new_criterion.cost: no engine, no participants, no new corpus
new_criterion.rationale: prescription_size already guards the positive cell against a vacuous prescription scoring well. The negative cell was unguarded.
new_criterion.result: run on all seventeen: 10 of 17 noise cells carry no information about the rule
